design.scope: 38 archived ticker/day contexts, 1-session point visits only; no new labels
design.bin_convention: lower-inclusive upper-exclusive; null upper means infinity
design.matching: within same symbol and decision date; remove identical levels first; maximum cardinality then minimum total absolute distance difference; no reuse; tie break by index; no outcomes in matching
design.identity: round(level,6), same as existing candidate inventory
design.stratified_standardization: same symbol/day/bin cells with both arms; weight=min(candidate counts); compute within-cell mean touch difference; report unmatched cells
design.unchanged_controls: identical levels retained separately, never called incremental observations
design.additional_constraints: No changed binning/caliper/selection after results. Both arms are point coordinates, no width/fill/profit interpretation. No p-values or independent-trial confidence intervals.

summary.range_basis: Point coordinate only (zero width), touch=low<=level<=high of next completed session; no financial range or fill. ATR is fixed within each context, so matching never changes ticker/day volatility.
limitations: Only two shared decision dates; candidates/tickers/dates are dependent
No later path after a 1-session contact; no 3/5/10/20 comparison supplied
Conditional support can become small after requiring distance comparability; unmatched cases stay visible
Coarse bins can retain different distances and asset distributions; within-context weighting is descriptive, not causal
Matching on distance changes the evaluated subset; no extrapolation to the discarded candidates
No ranking change, financial selection, p-values, calibrated probability, trade return or model judgment inferred
